normalized.description:
The Ariane 62 launcher will become the baseline launcher for the deployment of the Galileo satellite constellation from Galileo Batch 3 satellites. 
The deployment of the Galileo constellation using Ariane 62 implies the development of a dual launch dispenser.
Development and qualification of the Galileo Ariane 62 dispenser shall be completed by mid-2020 and a flight model shall be delivered for the first Galileo launch (at the earliest by December 2020) using the Ariane 62 launcher.
